breadth_first_discovery.principle: During discovery, prefer breadth to depth. Store a useful signal and move to another relevant part of the business.
do_not_do: Do not ask frequency simply because a repetitive task was selected.
Do not ask effort simply because a manual task was selected.
Do not ask irritation or pain scales.
Do not immediately investigate every selected item.
Do not require the respondent to explain why every non-selected capability is missing.

breadth_first_discovery.default_behavior_after_signal: Store the signal, map it to candidate business sections and Cobreo potentials, then continue scanning.
breadth_first_discovery.when_to_interrupt_breadth: Only when an answer is required immediately to prevent a clearly irrelevant branch or unsafe inference.

candidate_inventory.purpose: Accumulate many plausible opportunities before asking the respondent what deserves attention.

sources.explicit_signal: A selected situation directly suggests an improvement possibility.
sources.coverage_gap_hypothesis: A relevant capability was not selected. This is a hypothesis only.
sources.cross_signal: Two or more answers combine into a higher-value possibility, e.g. hours tracked + profitability ambition + no labor-cost visibility.
sources.ambition: Raises relevance but never creates a candidate alone.
sources.tools: Context only unless paired with a need/fit signal.

rules: Non-selection is never treated as proof of absence.
Do not show every candidate to the respondent.
Prefer candidates supported by explicit selection, cross-signal logic, or strong context + ambition relevance.
A candidate can be stored without asking another question.
Do not calculate pain or annoyance scores.
Do not use tool count as an opportunity score.
An early-stage 'not yet' answer can be useful evidence when paired with explicit intent.
Do not discard a candidate simply because no current process exists.
For startups, discovery can be about capabilities to create, not only systems to improve.

respondent_prioritization.principle: The respondent chooses every broad business topic they genuinely want to improve. This is a first-class intent signal and must not be artificially capped.

documentation_gap.what_we_could_explore_together_fr: Identifier ce qui mérite d’être documenté et choisir une façon simple de rendre cette information accessible au bon moment.

work_visibility.title_fr: Voir plus clairement où en sont les travaux
work_visibility.what_we_see_fr: Vous avez indiqué qu’il n’est pas toujours simple de voir où en sont les dossiers, travaux ou commandes.
work_visibility.what_could_improve_fr: Rendre l’état des travaux, les prochaines étapes et les éléments qui demandent de l’attention plus visibles.
work_visibility.what_it_could_bring_fr: Des priorités plus claires, des suivis plus simples et une meilleure coordination du travail.
work_visibility.what_we_could_explore_together_fr: Regarder comment donner une vue utile de l’avancement sans ajouter inutilement de gestion.

information_reentry.title_fr: Éviter de recopier la même information
information_reentry.what_we_see_fr: Vous avez indiqué que certaines informations sont recopiées ou saisies plus d’une fois.
information_reentry.what_could_improve_fr: Réutiliser plus directement l’information déjà disponible entre les étapes ou les outils concernés.
information_reentry.what_it_could_bring_fr: Moins de manipulations, moins de risques d’écart entre les versions et un travail plus fluide.
information_reentry.what_we_could_explore_together_fr: Identifier où l’information est reprise et regarder la façon la plus simple de réduire ces doubles manipulations.

customer_feedback_gap.title_fr: Mieux utiliser les retours clients pour décider quoi améliorer
customer_feedback_gap.what_we_see_rule: Only render a factual statement after explicit confirmation or a supporting cross-signal; otherwise phrase as a possibility.
customer_feedback_gap.what_could_improve_fr: Faire remonter plus clairement ce que les clients apprécient, demandent ou rencontrent afin d’orienter les améliorations.
customer_feedback_gap.what_it_could_bring_fr: Une meilleure lecture de l’expérience client et des signaux utiles pour faire évoluer l’offre ou le service.
customer_feedback_gap.what_we_could_explore_together_fr: Regarder quels retours valent la peine d’être recueillis et comment les rendre réellement utiles à la prise de décision.

profitability_visibility.title_fr: Mieux comprendre ce qui contribue réellement à la rentabilité
profitability_visibility.what_we_see_rule: Use only confirmed finance/team answers. Do not assume profitability is unavailable from one non-selection.
profitability_visibility.what_could_improve_fr: Relier les informations déjà disponibles sur le travail, les coûts ou les revenus pour obtenir une vue plus utile de la rentabilité.
profitability_visibility.what_it_could_bring_fr: Des décisions plus éclairées sur les prix, les types de travaux, les ressources et les priorités.
profitability_visibility.what_we_could_explore_together_fr: Regarder quelles données sont déjà disponibles et quelle vue de rentabilité serait réellement utile au dirigeant.

fallback_generation_rules: Never generate a fallback title from the section label.
A fallback opportunity must contain one explicit business activity + one improvement direction.
If the engine cannot write a concrete title from supported evidence, do not render a main opportunity card; keep the signal internal or ask one decision-changing followup.

company_context_policy.first_question_fr: Où en êtes-vous avec votre entreprise aujourd’hui?
rules: Do not ask the respondent to classify their sector or industry.
Only collect context that changes applicability, sequencing, wording or opportunity interpretation.
Context that can be researched or confirmed later should not consume early questionnaire attention.
If company_size indicates one person, automatically suppress team-only questions.
Use customer_types and work_models only because they directly help adapt relevant discovery sections.

forbidden_use: make a prospect answer a sector-classification question

internal_context_enrichment.rule: Missing enrichment must never block questionnaire completion or result generation.

rules: A prospect-visible service means 'worth exploring', not 'definitely the solution'.
internal_tool may be suggested when a concrete internal capability could benefit from a dedicated view, workflow, portal, tracker or knowledge tool.
custom_tool requires stronger evidence than internal_tool: important need + poor fit of standard/current approaches or a clearly specific workflow.
online_presence requires a customer/sales-facing need or respondent-confirmed interest.
automation requires a credible repetitive, transfer, reminder, generation, intake or workflow opportunity.
information_decision requires a visibility, information, metric, analysis, reporting or decision opportunity.
Show 1–3 supported services per section; maximum 4.
Do not show a section solely because it was selected earlier.
Do not show generic opportunity grades.
Do not expose internal lens ids.

service_recommendation_model.principle: V8 can suggest service forms more freely after respondent confirmation, but must distinguish generic service fit from a custom build claim.

evidence_required.operations_optimization: Selected/confirmed workflow, coordination, status, planning or process possibility.
evidence_required.automation: Selected/confirmed repetitive, transfer, reminder, generation, intake or predictable-action possibility.
evidence_required.information_decision: Selected/confirmed visibility, documentation, metric, analysis, reporting or information-use possibility.
evidence_required.customer_experience: Selected/confirmed client/prospect journey, feedback, onboarding, request, follow-up or service possibility.
evidence_required.online_presence: Selected/confirmed offer presentation, online discovery, website, inquiry or conversion possibility.
evidence_required.internal_tool: Selected/confirmed internal capability that could benefit from a dedicated tracker, dashboard, portal, workflow, knowledge tool or operational view.
evidence_required.custom_tool: Specific important workflow/need + evidence that current/standard approaches may not fit adequately.

rules: Respondent confirmation can satisfy relevance for a suggested possibility.
It does not prove a custom build is needed.
A simple internal tool may ultimately be a spreadsheet, configured SaaS, no-code tool, integration or custom software; the diagnostic does not decide that.
Never make 'custom tool' the default just because an internal tool opportunity exists.

calendar_event.privacy_rule: Do not include sensitive free-text answers.

Prevent double booking.

improve.when: A current process/capability exists and a supported gap, friction or fit issue exists.

optimize.when: A current process/capability works reasonably well but the respondent explicitly wants to improve it.

put_in_place.when: A relevant capability is not yet in place and the respondent has explicit near-term interest or an aligned declared ambition.

explore.when: The idea is relevant but evidence is not strong enough for improve/optimize/put_in_place.

healthy.when: A current capability appears adequate and there is no meaningful improvement or build interest.

rules: Do not force a problem label on an emerging company.
For early-stage businesses, 'put_in_place' is a first-class positive outcome.
A missing capability plus no interest remains not relevant.
A missing capability plus explicit interest can be surfaced without proving current friction.
Use 'À mettre en place' rather than 'À améliorer' when the capability does not yet exist.

emerging_opportunity_engine.purpose: Prevent startups and new processes from producing false 'nothing clear to prioritize' outcomes.

strong: declared ambition aligned with section + explicit 'not yet / too early / not structured' capability answer
respondent explicitly says they want to explore or put in place the capability
company is early-stage + declared ambition clearly requires the capability + scan confirms it is not yet in place
medium: company is early-stage + declared ambition aligned with section + section applies to the near-term business model
weak: ambition alone with no contextual applicability

emerging_opportunity_engine.candidate_rule: Strong and medium emerging evidence can generate a prioritization card. Weak evidence stays internal.
important_exception_to_existing_evidence: Current friction is NOT required for an emerging opportunity.
Current solution fit is NOT required when no solution/process exists yet.
emerging_opportunity_engine.fallback_rule: If no current-state opportunity candidates exist but explicit ambitions or explore-intent exist, generate emerging candidates before showing any 'nothing clear' message.

rules: This mapping creates candidates, not automatic service prescriptions.
For an early company, show the most relevant 3–5 section candidates, not every possible section.
Prefer sections explicitly reinforced by scan answers.

prioritization_empty_state.replacement: Always generate the V8 possibility review set. If the respondent selects none, record no_selected_priority without claiming no opportunity.
prioritization_empty_state.allowed_result_copy_fr: Vous n’avez pas identifié de priorité parmi les possibilités proposées pour le moment.

a specific business workflow need is established and standard/current tools are unlikely to fit

emerging_service_mapping.rule: Emerging service relevance must be tied to a declared near-term intention or explicit explore choice. Do not turn every missing startup capability into a service.

v8_discovery_contract.core_rule: The system never says that an enterprise has no opportunities. It may say that no current problem is evident or that none of the proposed possibilities is a priority for the respondent.

important_distinction.opportunity: A supported improvement or emerging capability.
important_distinction.possibility: A contextually relevant idea worth showing to the respondent for validation.

prospect_language_rules: Observed facts may be stated directly.
Emerging opportunities use 'à mettre en place' language.
Suggested possibilities use 'pourrait être utile / à considérer / à explorer' language.
Never turn a non-selection into 'vous ne faites pas X' unless separately confirmed.
Never present a generic industry best practice as a diagnosed problem.
v8_discovery_contract.empty_state_rule: There is no prospect-facing 'no opportunity' empty state in V8.

observed.definition: Explicit selected reality, fit gap, cross-signal or clearly supported current opportunity.

emerging.definition: Relevant capability is not yet in place and the respondent expressed compatible ambition/intent.
emerging.result_eligibility: Eligible after respondent interest or sufficiently explicit intent.

suggested.definition: Potentially beneficial capability inferred from context, ambition, applicable section or a meaningful non-selection.
suggested.result_eligibility: Must be confirmed by respondent before being treated as one of their result priorities.

respondent_confirmed.definition: Respondent explicitly selected an observed/emerging/suggested possibility on the V8 opportunity review screen.

rules: Suggested is not lower quality by definition; it is lower certainty about current need.
A suggested item may become highly relevant once the respondent chooses it.
A respondent can decline a suggested possibility without being challenged.

v8_possibility_generation.goal: Before asking the entrepreneur what matters, produce a diverse, useful set of possibilities rather than an empty state.
generation_order: emerging opportunities from ambitions + not-yet capabilities
suggested opportunities from applicable high-value capability library
v8_possibility_generation.fill_rule: If fewer than four candidates survive, fill from contextually applicable capability-library items, clearly marked 'À considérer'.
diversity_rules: Prefer candidates from at least three business sections when applicable.
Do not fill the list with multiple near-duplicates from one section.
Do not fill solely with software/tool ideas; include process, automation, information, client experience or decision opportunities when relevant.
Do not show team opportunities to a solo company unless the ambition is future hiring/growth and wording is explicitly future-oriented.
v8_possibility_generation.important_rule: The guarantee applies to possibilities shown for reflection, not to diagnosed problems or confirmed service needs.

rules: Suggested possibilities keep their inference basis internally.
Do not erase the distinction between respondent-confirmed and initially observed.
Use the 15-minute call to explore solution fit, not to retroactively justify a weak problem claim.

major_survivors: Outil interne as a common prospect-visible service
rejected: force respondent to choose at least one possibility

rules: Prefer topics with observed/emerging signals, then ambitions, then strong suggestions.
Avoid redundant topics.
Show no more than six.
Retain all micro-possibilities internally even when clustered.
v8_topic_clustering.selection_rule: No maximum. The respondent may select every displayed topic that feels worth improving.

v81_simulation_summary.stop_reason: Further simplification started removing useful distinctions. The next useful evidence should come from real users.

v83_revision_summary.scope: Targeted revision based on questionnaire fill-through feedback.
observed_feedback_from_review: The final improvement question is the most revealing respondent-intent screen.
A max-three cap prevents respondents from expressing all areas they genuinely want to improve.
The result statement 'Ce que vous avez choisi d’explorer' adds little value because it repeats selections.
Client service, work organization and manual-task questions felt partially redundant.
Questions must remain understandable when shown alone.
changes_kept: Final improvement topic selection has no maximum.
Selected topics become interpretation signals rather than a result receipt.
Results are reframed around observation, opportunity, gain potential and why.
Work-operations scan no longer asks about manual steps or repeated documents.
Client scan is explicitly about client-facing follow-up.
Manual simplification remains a dedicated concrete scan.
All three revised questions are self-contained.
changes_rejected: Removing the final topic question: rejected because it captures respondent intent after discovery.
Keeping a three-topic maximum: rejected because it suppresses valid respondent priorities.
Showing every selected topic as a result card: rejected because selection alone is not evidence of an opportunity.
Merging all operational, client and manual-friction questions into one checklist: rejected because it would create an overly broad, ambiguous screen.
v83_revision_summary.validation_status: Design-coherence revision only; not empirical user validation.
next_validation_focus: Do respondents naturally select more than three topics when allowed?
Does unrestricted selection improve expression without making the screen feel indecisive?
Do the revised client / operations / simplification boundaries eliminate the felt repetition?
Do result cards feel like analysis rather than a restatement of answers?
